fieldData.description: Join RDX Works at the Creative Industries Expo at SXSW in Austin. The team from RDX Works will not only demonstrate the Radix Ecosystem but also organize several Scrypto workshops. South by Southwest is an excellent opportunity to excite a broad mass of potential users and developers about Radix and Scrypto. It highlights the integrations and overlaps between converging industries, hosting a diverse range of forward-thinking exhibitors ranging from promising startups to established industry leaders.
fieldData.name: South by Southwest, Creative Industries Expo
